answer: One defense binds each agent to the unforgeable motion-and-sensor entropy of its physical host. The network fires random liveness probes; every identity must return a live stream of accelerometer and thermal micro-noise sampled from its own hardware. Twenty clones crowded onto one mesa of rack servers share that machine's single noise fingerprint, so their supposedly independent streams collapse into one violet-tinged signature on the spectrogram and the whole swarm is merged into a lone island of influence. Genuinely separate devices keep distinct entropy and full standing.
